fixes.why: The GPU/SPU SDRAM requests (alt) were issued whenever the registered ack was high, independently of the CPU requests (WRAM_READ/WRAM_WRITE/BIOS_READ instructs), so both could strobe in the same cycle and their sdram_read/sdram_write arguments were ORed. Upstream shipped with the SPU off (its SPU path halted with 0x95/0x96); with the Q-L1-14 SPU-in-SDRAM path every sound-on build ran away during the BIOS (hardware r16, r19b, r26-r29: PC ~0x80A81C2x), sound-off r13 booted. The boot bench gave the CPU priority, so it never showed this. The GPU/SPU request now waits while a CPU strobe is present.
fixes.new:
gpu_read_wait_ack | gpu_write_wait_ack | 
		spu_wait_ack | ^sdram_ack |
		psx.WRAM_READ | psx.WRAM_WRITE | psx.BIOS_READ : ; // Q-L1-16: a CPU strobe owns the cycle

fixes.why: Q-L1-16 T12 (found by the full-chain simulation Pocket/sim/fullchain, commit 5928005): the CPU SDRAM commands (psx.WRAM_READ/WRAM_WRITE/BIOS_READ) were strobed regardless of sdram_ack. One arriving while an SPU/GPU command was in flight was dropped by the adapter, and `if(sdram_ack) psx.wram_ack()/bios_ack()` then handed the other command's completion and stale dout to the CPU; with the SPU on (first SPU-RAM write of the BIOS SPU init) this ran the PC away to 0x80A81C20, as on hardware r16-r30. The CPU command is now held in cpu_pend_* while a GPU/SPU command is in flight and issued when it completes; the ack level reaches the CPU only while no GPU/SPU command is in flight and no CPU command is held. Simulated 14 s: BIOS logo and shell, 0 dropped, 0 scoreboard mismatches.

fixes.why: SPU DMA never ends for transfers over 128 KB: dma_count is 16 bits (it counts two per 32-bit word) but is compared with the 32-bit dma_size (blocks x block size x 2), so it wraps before it can match when size >= 65536. Hardware r36: the Umihara menu freezes after Start with dma_SPU.running set (the CPU waits for the DMA) while the SPU keeps issuing SDRAM requests; the game uploads its sound bank by SPU DMA. The author never used this path in kernel runs (his comment). 32 bits cannot wrap.
fixes.new: reg madr<21>, dma_count<32>; // Q-L1-16 T13: was <16>, wrapped before reaching dma_size

fixes.why: Hardware r37 (Umihara after Start, the SPU DMA fixed): the core stops with gpu.halt_code 0xA5, the author's debug halt for a GP0 command his GPU does not implement. The last command byte is on dbg_gpu<7:0>. The command is ignored instead (its parameter words, if any, are then parsed as commands).
